content:
Maya: Heads-up — I'm kicking off a sweep to standardize our microcopy phrase set and SDK snippets. We need a gating process so PRs don't regress phrasing across examples. Who owns the canonical 'phraseset' today?

Todd: I can take SDK snippets. I found ~12 samples using old keys (e.g., `voice:` -> `style:`). I'll open a draft PR that does automated replaces + tests.

Sophia: Thanks. Before any mass replace, we should lock down the golden phraseset and the tone tokens product approves. Eren, can you confirm the product-approved tones?

Eren: Product prefers these primary tones: `concise`, `helpful`, `formal`. Avoid `casual` in error messages. I can sign off on a short approved list.

Todd: Quick example of what I'll change in SDK snippets — replacing `voice` -> `tone` and normalizing a sample prompt:```js
// before
const res = client.generate({ model: 'x1', voice: 'friendly', prompt: 'Help me reset my pass' })

// after
const res = client.generate({ model: 'x1', tone: 'helpful', prompt: 'Help me reset my password' })
```I'll add a unit test that loads the snippet, runs the formatter, and asserts the canonical phrase from the golden set appears.

Maya: Proposed gating checklist:
1) Add a golden phraseset YAML under `/docs/phrases/goldenset.yml` (single source of truth)
2) Docs CI job `docs-lint` checks PR diffs against goldenset and flags replacements
3) SDK snippet PRs update examples + include snippet-level tests
4) Docs migration note / release note for runtime parity

Sophia: I'll add the `docs-lint` GH Action and a rule that warns if a changed sample contains an old token (`voice`) or a disallowed phrase. I'll also add a small test harness to fail on regressions.

Todd: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412 (WIP). It currently runs a sed-replace for `voice:` -> `tone:` and updates affected example outputs. Please don't merge until CI and goldenset are in place.

Sophia: Small nit — call out the migration mapping clearly in the PR description (e.g., `voice: friendly -> tone: helpful`), and add a link to runtime config so engineers know how fields map to the serving layer.

Maya: Action owners/timebox:
- Todd: SDK snippet PR and snippet tests (owner)
- Sophia: Add `docs-lint` + CI check (owner)
- Eren: Final sign-off on approved tone tokens (owner)
- Maya: Create initial goldenset doc and migration note (owner)
Target: EOD next Thursday. :calendar:

Eren: Ack — I'll review by Wednesday and flag any tone edge cases.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: `docs-ci` updated — new check `docs-lint` added to the CI matrix on branch `main`.
